saints.name: St. Leonard of Port Maurice
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: The great Franciscan missionary preacher of Italy who spread the devotion of the Stations of the Cross…
biography: Born at Porto Maurizio on the Ligurian coast in 1676, Leonard became a Franciscan of the Strict Observance and the most celebrated popular preacher of eighteenth-century Italy. Travelling from town to town, he gave parish missions and retreats that drew immense crowds and renewed the fervour of the people.

He did more than anyone to spread the devotion of the Way of the Cross, erecting hundreds of sets of Stations throughout Italy, including, by tradition, within the Colosseum in Rome. He also ardently promoted the doctrine of the Immaculate Conception. He died in Rome in 1751 and is a patron of parish missions and preachers.
saints.knownFor: Popular missions and the spread of the Stations of the Cross.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “St. Leonard of Port Maurice”
